invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.0915（零利润止损），或Qlib评分跌出前三，或融资费率Z-score超过100%（多头过度拥挤）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.0915 (break-even stop), or Qlib score drops out of top 3, or funding Z-score exceeds 100% (overly crowded longs).
